info.title: LifeLink API
info.description:
Blood availability, facility discovery, voluntary donation and emergency coordination.

**This document is generated from the live route table** (`backend/src/handlers/api.py`) by `scripts/generate_openapi.py`, so it cannot describe an endpoint that does not exist.

Every response uses one envelope: `{ data, meta?, correlationId }` on success and `{ error: { code, message, details? } }` on failure. Clients should branch on `error.code`, which is stable, rather than on the message, which is not.

**What this API does not do.** It does not reserve or allocate blood, does not determine clinical urgency, and does not certify clinical suitability. Availability figures are reported by facilities and carry both a freshness label and a separate independent-verification status.

servers.description: AWS deployment. The lifelink-dev stack is deployed and live in ap-southeast-2; substitute the deployed API id for apiId.

bearerAuth.description: Amazon Cognito access token in AWS; a locally issued development token when running locally. Roles and account status are read from the database on every request, not from token claims, so a suspended account is rejected immediately.

data.description: The response payload. Shape depends on the endpoint.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor. Pass back as ?cursor= to continue. Bound to the originating query.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code. Branch on this, not the message.
